sourceTitle: Simple and delicious Parmesan macaroni and cheese in bread machine
sourceText:
Simple and delicious Parmesan macaroni and cheese in bread machine
By: Kristina Vadeikaite
Published: Monday, May 16, 2016 - 9:52am

Ingredients




4 oz of pasta (1/4 of 16oz box, can be any pasta, but I used penne)
1/2 cup of whole or 2% milk
1 tbsp of unsalted butter
1 tbsp of all-purpose flour
1 cup of Parmesan cheese
Some pepper and chili

Preparation

1 First cook all ingredients. Pasta: bring water to boil and add some salt, then add pasta into boiling water and cook it for 12min. Parmesan: grate cheese. Butter: melt it in the microwave (about 15sec). 2 Preparation: put milk, flour, melted butter, cheese and spices to bread machine. Select baking cycle and leave the sauce cooking for 10 min. Stir it up and add cooked pasta. Leave all the ingredients in bread machine for another 10min. Serve and eat!
